使用喷火器主动攻击对战时，触发<buf ID=900064>[余光锁定]</buf>，使用对侧手臂的喷火器优先攻击范围内其他目标，对目标及路径上所有目标造成<color=#F74848>15%</color>的<buf ID=900065>[火焰伤害]</buf>；

200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700034.name: Impending Victory
700034.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, if the HP% is higher than the target's, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

201203.name: 采访许可
201203.describe: 使自身获得<buf ID=2012032>[超高温！]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合，然后可继续移动<color=#F74848>2</color>格，移动后可继续发起攻击

201204.name: 熊熊盛意
201204.describe: 使用喷火器攻击主目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.4</color>倍伤害，并对路径上的其他目标造成<color=#F74848>20%</color>的<buf ID=900065>[火焰伤害]</buf>，若主目标位于友方燃烧地形上，战后触发<color=#F74848>1</color>次该地形效果

201205.name: 链路熔毁

201206.name: 热力迸发

201207.name: 爆点头条

201208.name: 烈火燎原

200021.name: CEC 3

200022.name: Power Innovation 2

200034.name: Perfect Position 2

200035.name: Perfect Position 3

200036.name: Perfect Position 4

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.
